meta.title: Clear rates, for every sailing.
meta.description: Compare published FCL ocean freight from China to West Africa and request a manual quotation.

home.title: Clear rates, for every sailing.
home.lede: Compare published FCL ocean freight from China to West Africa. Confirmed charges are calculated on the server. Anything unpublished stays marked as unconfirmed.
home.heroTitle: Full container shipping from China to West Africa
home.heroLede: Guangzhou Nansha and Ningbo to Abidjan and Tema
home.laneQuoteBody: Search published sell rates by port, container and shipment date.
home.laneCompareBody: See carriers, transit time and charges for the same route together.
home.laneInquiryBody: Send the details to the team when no rate matches or the cargo needs a check.
home.photoCaption: Illustrative photograph. It is not a claim about a vessel, schedule or partnership.

results.title: Carrier comparison
results.hint: Choose the ports, container and date to see published sell rates.
results.emptyBody: There is no reviewed and published sell rate for this search. Change the conditions or send a manual request.
results.unavailable: Rates cannot be searched right now. Retry or contact the team.
results.unavailableBody: This environment is not connected to the rate database, so no rates can be returned. Retry, or contact the team.
results.demo: Demo rates are included. They are not a commercial offer.

inquiry.title: Request a manual quotation
inquiry.lede: Send the shipment details. A person will reply. Submitting the form does not create a rate.
inquiry.special: Batteries, liquids or other special cargo
inquiry.fileHint: Up to 5 files, 8 MB each. PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP.

servicesPage.title: Ocean freight from China to West Africa
servicesPage.lede: From a published rate to a manual check, each step stays explicit.
servicesPage.quoteBody: Search published FCL sell rates from Guangzhou Nansha and Ningbo to Abidjan and Tema, matched to the container and shipment date.
servicesPage.compareBody: See published carriers, reference transit times and charges for the same route together. Unpublished items stay marked unconfirmed.
servicesPage.manualBody: Send the shipment to the team when no rate matches, or when the cargo or a local charge needs a separate check.
servicesPage.step1Body: Select the load port, discharge port, container and planned shipment date.
servicesPage.step2Body: Review published sell rates, reference transit time and known charges.
servicesPage.step3: Save a quote or send an inquiry
servicesPage.step3Body: After sign-in you can save that quote, or send a special request to the team.

faqPage.title: Questions
faqPage.lede: How published rates, charges and accounts work.

contactPage.lede: Tell us about the shipment and we will quote the route and cargo.
contactPage.sideBody: Use this when the cargo is special, a charge is unconfirmed, or the shipment needs its own price.
